Maya: Quick async — kernel/batching/KV/perf check-in
Maya: Yesterday: landed KV TTL fallback for read-through cache; fixed race in hot-shard prefetch. Bench: 99th-token latency down ~18% on small batches.
Maya: Blockers: canary shows occasional OOM when seq_len spikes above 3k on p4d; need kernel guard. Also need CR review on PR #4127.
Maya: Today: push guard, address comments, run full batch vs microbatch bench sweep.

Liam: On review, I've got +1 on main logic, leaving a comment about metrics labels. Will do final pass today.

Jordan: Ran end-to-end perf this morning on stable: microbatch size 16 vs 32 numbers attached:
Jordan: ```
# run
./bench_runner --model llama-13b --batch 16 --seq 2048 --iters 500
# result: p95=42ms p99=120ms tokens/s=1850
``` 
Jordan: When we enable KV prefix-cache, p99 drops to ~95ms but tail still spikes on mixed seq.

Sasha: KV eviction test: I pushed a script to infra-testing branch. Observed higher thrash if we evict >30% keys on warmup. Suggest increasing warmup percentage.

Maya: @Sasha can you post the script link? Also @Jordan can you re-run with seq distribution skewed (80% short 128, 20% long 2k)?

Jordan: Yep, will run and share numbers by EOD.

runtime-bot: Deploy canary started for kernel-guard branch on kube-cluster-3 :rotating_light:

Liam: FYI I'm pairing with infra later to check memory limits; may bump container memory for canary.

Maya: Thanks — call out if you need me to pause canary. Otherwise I'll open follow-up issue for spike detection alert.

Sasha: Script: git://repo/infra-testing/kv-evict-check.sh — includes histogram dumps.

Maya: OK, that's it from me. Drop short notes here when you have numbers. :thumbsup:
